text:
Maya Green: Drafting release notes for 2.5.0. Target deploy Thu 02:00 UTC. Short internal blurb + embargo line needed.
Ethan Brooks: Can you paste the one-paragraph blurb? Ops digest wants 1-2 lines.
Maya Green: Blurb: "Release 2.5.0: runtime stability, reduced tail-latency, and optional q5 quantization for lower cost. Deploy Thu 02:00 UTC; brief canary then full rollout. No user-visible prompt changes."
Ravi Shah: Canary plan request: tiered by customer class. 3% paid -> 15% paid -> 50% paid -> 100% all. Keep free tier on fallback.
Ivy Nguyen: I'll update routing rules. Adding health checks: p50 < 160ms, p95 < 480ms, error_rate < 0.7%.
Maya Green: Include pinned model + artifact: model=redwood/argent-q5-v1, artifact=sha256:aa11bb22cc33. Add rollback criteria.
Ethan Brooks: Rollback owner: Ethan. Manual rollback: `/deploy rollback --to snapshot 9987654200`. Auto-fallback if error_rate > 0.7% for 4m.
LegalBot: Reminder: include legal blurb if tokenizer adjustments change token billing. If token count can change, flag billing team.
Maya Green: Noted. Add line: "No expected billing impact; monitor token-count metrics and alert billing if +/ - >5% per-route."
Ravi Shah: DeployBot dry-run? We should run in staging and attach to thread.
DeployBot: Dry-run scheduled by Ravi Shah. Use `/deploy start --dry-run 9987654321`. Steps: create canary, set routing, run smoke-suite.
Ivy Nguyen: I'll open infra PR for rollout config and pin. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1760
Maya Green: Internal announce draft (to post T-1h): "2.5.0 deploy Thu 02:00 UTC. Canary plan and rollback criteria in this thread. Oncall: Ravi Shah. Rollback owner: Ethan Brooks. See infra/playbooks/release-2.5.0.md"
Ethan Brooks: Adding what-to-watch list: p50, p95, error_rate, token-count delta, GPU mem. I'll add alert links.
Ravi Shah: Oncall confirmed. I'll be in channel T-20m.
Maya Green: Final checklist: 1) Ivy merge PR 2) DeployBot dry-run green 3) Legal ok 4) Maya posts pinned blurb at T-1h 5) Ethan on standby for rollback.
LegalBot: Legal review passed; no customer-facing changes.
DeployBot: Dry-run OK. Reminder for live: `/deploy start --thread 9987654321`
Maya Green: Posting pinned internal announce now. Will update here with post-deploy summary.
Ethan Brooks: Will post roll-forward or rollback timeline here after deploy.
Ivy Nguyen: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1760 (merged).
